description: A utility class providing methods for accessing, manipulating, and caching properties files, including support for locale-specific and XML formats. Includes resource bundle management and custom XML properties parsing.

classes.name: UtilProperties
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for property file access, resource bundle handling, XML properties parsing, and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: UtilResourceBundle
classes.description: A custom extension of ResourceBundle that implements caching and supports OFBiz custom XML property formats.

classes.name: ExtendedProperties
classes.description: An extension of Properties that supports parsing OFBiz-specific XML properties files.

methods.name: propertyValueEquals
methods.description: Compares the value of a property to a compare string; returns true if they are equal.

methods.name: propertyValueEqualsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Compares the value of a property to a compare string ignoring case.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the property value from the specified resource, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Loads Properties from a given resource or URL, utilizing caching.

methods.name: resolvePropertiesUrl
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL for a properties file based on resource name and locale.

methods.name: xmlToProperties
methods.description: Parses an XML input stream into Properties, supporting OFBiz custom XML formats.

methods.name: getResourceBundle
methods.description: Loads a resource bundle with caching, for a given resource name and locale.
